valueRouteClaims.text: Select: Validators pay protocol fees through a bilateral agreement booked against the Select bond: 20 bps to Marinade plus up to 10 bps to the validator, on TVL annually.
It is a lending vault, so Marinade takes a 5% performance fee on the net interest earned.
Revenue Allocation Under MIP-22 , 10% of protocol revenue is allocated to programmatic open-market MNDE buybacks .
The MNDE bought is distributed to eligible MNDE stakers in Marinade Realms through the MNDE Staking Rewards Program.
MIP-22 also seeded the MNDE-mSOL pool with 10M MNDE from the DAO treasury.
This is a different program from the earlier MIP-11 buybacks, which MIP-17 paused in favour of protocol-owned liquidity, and from MIP-13 Active Staking Rewards, which is closed.
Unlocking your tokens to get back your MNDE will start a 30-day unlock process.
